# Electric Dirt Bike Australia

> Australian online dealer of electric dirt bikes, electric motorbikes, e-bikes, kids electric bikes, lithium battery packs and chargers (Sur-Ron, Talaria, Stark Varg, KTM SX-E, E-Ride Pro, RTR eBike and more), dispatched from Mittagong NSW with a 12-month Australian warranty.

- Business: Electric Dirt Bike Australia (EDBA), ABN 98 611 685 977
- Location: Unit 4, 18-20 Bowral Rd, Mittagong NSW 2575, Australia (online store, nationwide delivery; workshop pickup by arrangement)
- Phone / WhatsApp: +61 420 128 746
- Email: sales@electricdirtbikeaustralia.com.au
- Hours: Mon - Fri: 8:30 AM - 5:30 PM AEST | Sat: 9:00 AM - 2:00 PM
- Currency: AUD (prices include GST)
- Free freight: orders over $1,500 AUD; flat $200 AUD below that; minimum order $500 AUD
- Discount: 10% off when paying with crypto or PayID
- Warranty: 12 Months Comprehensive Australian Factory Warranty
- Catalogue: 155 products, 124 buying guides. Off-road electric dirt bikes are for private property and designated off-road parks; road use depends on model and state rules.
